full_staged_diff:
diff --git a/src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/heavy.rs b/src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/heavy.rs
index 5d9f5778b..2221ad9fa 100644
--- a/src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/heavy.rs
+++ b/src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/heavy.rs
@@ -155,13 +155,17 @@ case "$user_message" in
   *provider-host-executed-input-wait-timeout*)
     printf '%s\n' '{"type":"control_request","request_id":"ctrl-input-wait-timeout","request":{"subtype":"can_use_tool","tool_name":"run_shell_command","input":{"command":"input-wait-helper"},"tool_use_id":"toolu-input-wait-timeout"}}'
     if IFS= read -r response; then
-      case "$response" in
-        *'"behavior":"host_executed_shell"'*'"exit_code":130'*'"input_wait":{"detected":true'*'"interrupted":true'*'"reason":"input-wait-timeout"'*'"status":"timed_out"'*)
-          printf '%s\n' '{"type":"assistant","session_id":"sess-host-executed-input-wait-timeout","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Host-executed input-wait timeout result received."}]}}'
-          printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","session_id":"sess-host-executed-input-wait-timeout","is_error":false,"result":"done"}'
-          exit 0
-          ;;
-      esac
+      for expected in '"behavior":"host_executed_shell"' '"exit_code":130' '"input_wait":{"detected":true' '"interrupted":true' '"reason":"input-wait-timeout"' '"status":"timed_out"'; do
+        case "$response" in
+          *"$expected"*) ;;
+          *) response=; break ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      if [ -n "$response" ]; then
+        printf '%s\n' '{"type":"assistant","session_id":"sess-host-executed-input-wait-timeout","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Host-executed input-wait timeout result received."}]}}'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","session_id":"sess-host-executed-input-wait-timeout","is_error":false,"result":"done"}'
+        exit 0
+      fi
     fi
     printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"error","session_id":"sess-host-executed-input-wait-timeout","is_error":true,"result":"missing input-wait timeout result"}'
     exit 1
checks: 仅Linux raw_cli input-wait fixture shell分支修改；不改产品控制协议、执行引擎或序列化。
六个字面谓词完整保留：behavior=host_executed_shell、exit_code=130、input_wait对象以detected=true开头、interrupted=true、reason=input-wait-timeout、status=timed_out。取消的是这些谓词之间的顺序耦合，不是值要求。
for循环所有expected为单引号常量；case使用*"$expected"*按字面匹配，中途失败清空response并break。成功只在六次匹配全部通过且response非空时发出原assistant/result并exit0，否则原错误结果exit1。
IFS= read -r仍按单行读取，未eval response、未引入动态shell代码/命令替换/外部依赖；无凭据、权限、破坏性动作或新文件操作。
从该测试let old_path起的全部后续正文与HEAD逐字节相同，保留handoff timeout30s、input-wait timeout1s、不得输入救援自动interrupt的输入序列及所有输出断言/cleanup。
既有raw_cli文件与测试分层匹配，无新增module/public API/依赖或production大文件增长。
读取控制JSON确认candidate_fixed 2正控exit0、12负控exit1；两种sort_keys各对六字段逐一破坏，控制记录fixture_sha256等于staged heavy.rs完整文件SHA256。main原始失败/成功顺序对照未被覆盖。
limitations: 本轮不构建、不执行shell控制或真实PTY动态测试；上述正负控是读取既有记录，不是本review新执行。
匹配器仍是原有compact JSON字面片段匹配，不验证完整JSON结构/重复键/类型/跨对象归属，也不承诺支持任意空白或input_wait内部字段顺序；这些为既有fixture边界，不把它描述为通用JSON语义parser。
字段分离后有意允许六个已要求片段之间顺序变化；未覆盖恶意构造重复字段/跨对象payload，本fixture由测试驱动产品输出，不是产品信任边界解析器。
未读取旧token或wire内容；只读取staged代码和指定合成控制摘要。
人工L3源码检查，非安全工具扫描；所查脚本目录未发现专用L3入口。
